data.name: Text.MainWindow.PrivacyPolicy
data.value: ### PML 2 Privacy Policy (Key Edition) **Important notice:** We use [Sentry](https://sentry.io) for error tracking and performance monitoring to improve software stability. Data is stored on Sentry's servers located in the European Union. ### 1. Scope of Information Collection - **Personal data**: username, email address, tunnel information (such as average API duration, launch failures, etc.) - **Device data**: device identifiers, operating system version, crash stacks and error logs - **Usage behavior**: feature clicks, session duration, error logs ___ **Note:** Telemetry data does not include sensitive information such as your account password or tunnel contents. ### 2. Use of Information - Providing core services (account verification, data synchronization) - Improving user experience (bug fixes, feature improvements) - Error monitoring and performance analysis (via Sentry) ### 3. Data Sharing **We do not sell user data**. It is only shared in the following cases: - With your explicit consent - To fulfill legal obligations - When necessary for cooperation with third-party service providers (such as cloud services) ___ ### 4. Your Rights You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, and you can disable telemetry data collection in the settings. **Contact:** [Email](mailto:im@rycb.tech) | [Website](https://www.rycb.tech/) ___ For the full privacy policy, please see: [PML 2 Privacy Policy](https://docs.rycb.tech/pml-2/policy)
